title: 第5章 鱼来第6章 晋升筑基
slug: 掌门师伯新收了个女徒弟
content_zh:
此时，眼前的湖面上不知何时已凝结了一层薄薄的冰霜。
下一刻，鱼竿开始传来抖动。
反应过来的周清无暇顾及心中的惊喜，急忙抓起鱼竿，双脚分开，微微下蹲。
心脏激动地怦怦直跳，但神情却极为专注。
他轻轻抬起鱼竿，前端被鱼线拉扯，弯成了一道夸张的弧线。
接着，他缓慢且有节奏地收线，顿时感觉到水中传来一股更强的寒气与巨力。
周清不敢掉以轻心，因为此时鱼竿承受着巨大的拉力，在半空中弯曲得如同一张大弓。
“鱼来！”
周清在心中大喊。
他猛地一用力，随着水花溅起的声音，一条雪白的鱼儿生猛地甩着尾巴被拉出了湖面，其身上的水珠纷纷坠落，在湖面砸出浅浅的涟漪。
看着落在草地上不断挣扎的鱼儿，以及那迅速蔓延的冰霜，周清简直不敢相信自己真的在这个不起眼的地方钓到了一条冰魄幽鳞鱼。
趁着没人注意这边，他赶紧把鱼扔进鱼篓藏好。
随后，他再次甩出鱼竿，佯装悠闲地躺了下来，但心情却久久无法平静。
“发了发了，这次真的发了！”
周清又偷偷瞄了一眼，确认自己没有眼花。
鱼篓中的冰魄幽鳞鱼通体洁白如雪，宛如由最纯净的冰晶雕琢而成，鱼身线条流畅，鳞片紧密排列，闪烁着微弱的银光。
尤其是它那宽大而柔软的鱼鳍，如同薄纱般轻盈。
“还挺漂亮的！”
周清喃喃自语，心中更加欢喜。
这时，远处的几名核心弟子似乎察觉到了什么，纷纷朝这边看过来。

当看到岸边周清那慵懒的模样时，他们无奈地摇了摇头，随后更加专注地钓起鱼来。
【忽略点+1】
【忽略点+1】
【忽略点+1】
…………
那悦耳的声音在耳边回荡，让周清的心情越发愉悦。
直至黄昏将至，他的鱼竿再次而动，随之而来还有那结冰的湖面。
周清满眼都是难以置信。
“难道我这辈子的运气都用在这儿了？”
在确认没人注意到自己后，他赶紧按照之前的方法，将鱼拉出水面。
不出所料，又是一条冰魄幽鳞鱼。
“难道此地是个绝佳的钓位？”
他将鱼敲晕收好，收起鱼竿开始研究四周，然而周围看上去很是平平无奇。
难道是天赋技能降低存在感？
“老四，看啥呢？我找你半天了！”三师兄闫小虎的声音从远处传来，在他身边还跟着两个有说有笑的核心弟子，看样子彼此关系还不错。
周清立刻站直身子，笑着说道：“没什么，随便看看，三师兄，你们钓得怎么样？”
闫小虎一脸晦气地扬了扬手中的空鱼篓，说道：“这冰魄幽鳞鱼太难钓了，纯粹靠运气，你选的这个地方也不怎么样啊，一看就没什么钓鱼经验。”
content_en:
At this time, a thin layer of frost had condensed on the lake in front of me.
The next moment, the fishing rod began to shake.
After reacting, Zhou Qing had no time to take into account the surprise in his heart. He hurriedly grabbed the fishing rod, spread his legs apart, and squatted slightly.
His heart was beating with excitement, but his expression was extremely focused.
He gently lifted the fishing rod, and the front end was pulled by the fishing line and bent into an exaggerated arc.
Then, he slowly and rhythmically reeled in the line, and suddenly felt a stronger cold air and great force coming from the water.
Zhou Qing did not dare to take it lightly, because at this time the fishing rod was under huge tension and bent like a big bow in mid-air.
"Come fish!"
Zhou Qing shouted in his heart.
He exerted force suddenly, and with the sound of water splashing, a snow-white fish was pulled out of the lake with its tail violently swinging. The water droplets on its body fell one after another, creating shallow ripples on the lake surface.
Looking at the struggling fish falling on the grass and the rapidly spreading frost, Zhou Qing couldn't believe that he had actually caught an Ice Soul Scale Fish in this inconspicuous place.
While no one was paying attention, he quickly threw the fish into the fish basket and hid it.
Then, he threw out the fishing rod again and pretended to lie down leisurely, but his mood could not be calm for a long time.
"I've made it, I've really made it this time!"
Zhou Qing took another sneak peek to make sure he was not dazzled.
The Ice Soul Nether Scale Fish in the fish basket is as white as snow, as if it were carved from the purest ice crystals. The lines of the fish body are smooth, the scales are closely arranged, and they shine with a faint silver light.
Especially its wide and soft fins, as light as gossamer.
"It's quite beautiful!"
Zhou Qing murmured to himself, feeling even more happy.
At this time, several core disciples in the distance seemed to have noticed something, and they all looked this way.
When they saw Zhou Qing's lazy appearance on the shore, they shook their heads helplessly, and then focused more on fishing.
[Ignore point +1]
[Ignore point +1]
[Ignore point +1]
…………
The sweet voice echoed in his ears, making Zhou Qing feel even happier.
Until dusk was approaching, his fishing rod moved again, and with it came the frozen lake.
Zhou Qing's eyes were full of disbelief.
"Have I spent all my luck here?"
After confirming that no one noticed him, he quickly pulled the fish out of the water according to the previous method.
As expected, it was another Ice Soul Nether Scale Fish.
"Is this an excellent fishing spot?"
He knocked the fish unconscious and put it away, put away the fishing rod and began to study the surroundings, but the surroundings looked very ordinary.
Could it be that the innate skills reduce the sense of presence?
"Fourth brother, what are you looking at? I've been looking for you for a long time!" The voice of third senior brother Yan Xiaohu came from a distance. He was accompanied by two core disciples who were talking and laughing. It seemed that they had a good relationship with each other.
Zhou Qing immediately stood up straight and said with a smile: "It's nothing, just take a look, Third Brother, how was your fishing?"
Yan Xiaohu raised the empty fish basket in his hand with an ominous look on his face and said, "It's so difficult to catch the Ice Soul Scale Fish. It depends purely on luck. The place you chose isn't that good at all. You don't have any fishing experience at first glance."
